title: Mehandi Laga Ke Rakhna
desc: Raja secures a school job alongside Kajal to appease his father, only to be slapped after confessing his love. Later, they cross paths again at a family wedding where his kindness wins her heart.

title: Rishton Ka Batwara
desc: Members in a family argue over property claims and take each other to court. However, this dispute drives a wedge in their relationships which affects future generations.

title: Saas Bina Chain Kaha Re
desc: Chaos ensues as two mothers-in-law and two daughters-in-law share the same living space. They attempt to navigate their daily lives but end up getting into unnecessary arguments.

title: Saas Kamal Bahu Dhamal
desc: After arriving in a village that has been cursed by a sage, Lakshmi, a well-educated bride, resolves to find a solution.

title: Karz Virasat Ke
desc: Kashi, a young man estranged from his father, falls in love with a beautiful woman, Suman. However, the latter's family disapproves of their relationship.

title: Bhakti Dhaam
desc: A compilation of uplifting religious melodies and devotional tracks is played back-to-back to create a serene atmosphere for people seeking daily spiritual guidance.
